note: Both sets are accurate on the five shared claims (rated speed 1173.7 rpm, 47,402.91 N·m saturation, 15,000 N·m/s rate limit, high drivetrain damping, no torsional-vibration loop), with faithful quotes and correct bindings. Set B additionally captures the important conditional torque logic (Region-3 computation when the previous blade-pitch command is 1° or greater) and the gain-scheduled PI control method with its Region 3 condition, both well supported. Set A instead adds the single-DOF model's degree of freedom and the control goal, which are correct but less central, and it omits the conditional statement entirely. B therefore covers more of the key engineering content without introducing errors.
remarks: Both sets omit the stated rationale/trade-off (improved output power quality at the expense of short-term generator and gearbox overloading) and the fact that the blade-pitch system takes over in Region 3; these are secondary but useful context. Set B's 'control input' attribute is slightly generic but the value and quote are correct.
